input:
We’ve seen the same loss reported through two channels — phone and web — and no system warning appeared, creating a duplicate loss report that complicates our reserves and payments.
Duplicate loss reports are created because the system fails to warn about reports coming from multiple channels.

Also, repair updates missing — we’re on the phone daily with garages because there’s no live status.
Customers cannot see live repair updates, forcing them to call garages daily.

Just that we’re losing time daily on this — it’s not sustainable without better visibility and planning.
The team is losing time every day because they lack sufficient visibility and planning.

Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble accessing the documents section — it keeps timing out when I try to pull up reserves for policyholders.
The user cannot open the documents section because it times out when retrieving reserves for policyholders.

when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks.
Garage estimate files are auto‑sorted into the wrong document category, requiring manual re‑assignment and risking missed evidence.

I’m having trouble accessing the claims module — it’s saying my login credentials aren’t valid.
The user cannot log into the claims module because their credentials are rejected.

That’s the goal — thanks for helping us get ...
The customer needs assistance to achieve their goal.

Just confirming — does enterprise include unlimited integrations with garage systems?
The customer is unsure whether the enterprise plan includes unlimited integrations with garage systems.

Claims: click "Next"...Claims: click "Overview", dead x1
Clicking Next then trying to go to Overview results in a dead end.

Good morning, Deryn. I’m calling about our team’s daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages.
The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration.

Also, we’ve had a duplicate loss report issue — same incident logged twice, no alert triggered at intake.
Duplicate loss reports are created without triggering alerts.

We need predictability so our staff don’t have to keep relearning where things are.
Staff must constantly relearn where things are because the platform lacks predictability.

Tasks: click "Save", rage x3
The user repeatedly encounters errors when trying to save changes.

We’re getting renewal price concern from several of our biggest clients—they’re asking why their quotes increased so much, and it’s putting pressure on our retention team.
Clients are concerned that their renewal quotes have increased significantly, creating pressure on the retention team.

Great — we’ll be ready to go live once the upload files together issue is resolved.
The customer cannot go live because the system cannot upload files together.

Right now, we’re manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice, which eats up time we could spend on supplier coordination or reporting.
Manually cross-checking each new claim to prevent duplicates consumes excessive time.

Just wanted to flag something urgent on our end.
The customer has an urgent issue that needs immediate attention.

Also, our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
Report totals shown in the dashboard do not match the numbers in exported files, causing confusion.

It’s messy when the same claim twice comes in — one by phone, one online, and the system doesn’t flag it.
Duplicate claims submitted through different channels are not being identified by the system.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal as I’m locked out and can’t access documents or reserves.
The user is locked out of the claims portal and cannot access documents or reserves.

Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1 ... Claims: click "Next"
The "Link to existing claim" button is broken, stopping users from linking a claim.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The customer lacks Welsh-language letters for policyholders, which is required for renewal terms.

Also, garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it.
Garage estimates are incorrectly routed to the correspondence category, requiring manual recategorization and causing evidence to be missed.

Your last update moved some controls without warning... Our teams had to retrain because of unexpected interface changes — and we’re still seeing errors from it.
Unexpected interface changes in the latest update forced the team to retrain and caused errors.

We’ve got a few questions about how claims get assigned to our teams.
The customer is unclear about how claims are assigned to their teams.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates, so we’re relying on manual workarounds until automation lands.
Claim progress notifications are sent manually, causing delays and reliance on workarounds.

I’m trying to reconcile the latest reserves update with the payments we’ve processed for policyholders this week, and the numbers aren’t lining up.
The user cannot match the latest reserves update with the payments processed, resulting in a discrepancy.

Thank you — that’s exactly the kind of support we need to streamline our claims handling.
The customer lacks sufficient support to make their claims handling more efficient.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception... Claims: click "Save"
Exporting a report to CSV triggers an error exception, preventing the download.

Claims: click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The 'Link to existing claim' button does not work and leads to a dead link.

I’m looking to streamline our claims handling, especially around documents and reserves tracking... can you confirm your availability on Tuesday or Thursday?
The customer needs to schedule an onboarding walkthrough to streamline claims handling.

I know the official way to upload files together isn’t live yet, but I’ve got a temporary method that’ll let you add multiple documents without doing them one at a time — it’s not ideal, but it’ll get you through until the feature ships on 6 October.
Users must upload files one by one because batch uploading isn’t available yet.

Will do — thanks for the quick reply. We’ll circle back if the documents or payments tabs give us grief after the fix.
The user is concerned that the documents or payments tabs might cause issues after a fix.

We’ve got a few items we need to resolve ahead of our renewal.
The customer has unresolved items that must be addressed before their contract renewal.

How do I upload policyholder documents into the system without triggering a reserve alert?
Uploading policyholder documents triggers a reserve alert, preventing smooth upload.

I also want to make sure roles are assigned correctly so only authorized staff can adjust reserves.
Ensuring that only authorized staff can adjust reserves due to role‑assignment concerns.

Morning Alwen, thanks for setting this up. Havren Harthwick here from Pendleford Motor Mutual.
The customer needed the Keelwater claims platform set up for their organization.

Hi Bryn, I’m Jorrin from Fellbrook Fine Art & Specie — we’re trying to submit a high-value specie claim but hit a snag with document uploads.
The user cannot upload required documents when submitting a high-value specie claim.

we’ve got a lot of policyholder files to attach to claims, so we’re hoping there’s a way to handle multiple file upload efficiently. We’ve got a number of claims files to attach and really need the multiple file upload capability to save time — it’s a bit of a bottleneck doing them one by one right now.
Uploading claim files one by one is slow and creates a bottleneck.

That’d be great — I’ve cleared my cache already and tried on two devices, but the filters vanish after I log out.
Saved filters disappear after logging out.

We’re seeing cases where the same claim twice appears because the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake — we’ve had to manually link them after the fact, which delays payments and reporting.
Duplicate claims are created because the system fails to warn staff of existing matching incidents, forcing manual linking and causing delays.

Looking forward to it — your platform seems like it could really streamline our claims handling.
The customer finds their current claims handling process cumbersome and wants it to be more efficient.

The lack of real-time visibility into garage progress is forcing us to chase manually — garage progress visibility is a blocker we need solved ASAP.
The team cannot see garage progress in real time, so they have to chase updates manually.

It’s mostly the commercial property claims under policyholder ID C8821 — the ones we submitted last Tuesday. The payments show as pending but reserves aren’t updating.
Payments remain pending and claim reserves do not update after submitting commercial property claims.

First, our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases.
The motor and commercial teams disagree on whether claim allocation should be automated or manually controlled for complex cases.

That’s a key point for us — we need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides.
Reserves must be updated in real time but currently require manual overrides.

Hi Bryn, we’re having some trouble navigating the claims module after the last update — things aren’t where we left them.
Users cannot find familiar locations in the claims module after the recent update.

We rely heavily on your claims and reporting features — we don’t want to lose those, but the cost is concerning.
The customer is worried that the price increase may force them to lose essential claims and reporting functionality.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to set up some saved filters on the claims list to help my team track high-priority cases, but I can’t seem to lock them in properly.
The user cannot lock saved filters on the claims list.

I’m trying to upload a claim document but the system says I’ve selected the wrong document category — can you help?
The user cannot upload a claim document because the system reports an incorrect document category.

I think we need a clearer way to manage reserves and supplier payments.
The team lacks a clear method for managing reserves and supplier payments.

We’re running into delays because reserve adjustments above our team’s limit just sit there until the one approver comes back — no backup, no delegation, and claims pile up.
Delays occur because reserve adjustments above the team’s limit wait for a single approver with no backup or delegation, causing claim backlogs.

click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The user cannot proceed because the link to an existing claim is non‑functional.

When a handler needs to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it goes into an approval waiting list — but if the approver’s out, nothing moves until they return.
Approvals get stuck when the designated approver is unavailable, causing delays in reserve adjustments.

when assigning staff to different claim roles, we can’t seem to map our existing sign-on groups to those roles directly... that mapping isn’t available, and it’s causing extra manual work for our team.
The platform doesn't let us map our existing sign‑on groups directly to claim roles, forcing extra manual work.

Understood. Can we get a timeline? Our month-end close depends on reconciling those numbers accurately.
The customer needs a clear timeline because month‑end close relies on accurate number reconciliation.

That would help a lot... I’ll send over a few recent examples for context.
The primary approver cannot be replaced when they are unavailable.

we’ve got a situation where a policyholder reported the same incident both over the phone and through the web portal, and it created two separate claims without any alert.
Duplicate claims are created when a policyholder reports the same incident through multiple channels, and the system provides no alert.

We’re counting on it — especially for managing suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions.
They struggle to manage suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions.

Appreciate that. Also, can you confirm if the supplier integrations support our third-party adjusters?
The customer is unsure whether the platform's supplier integrations work with their third‑party adjusters.

We’ve had some trouble recently with attaching multiple files to claims — it’s been clunky.
Attaching multiple files to claims is cumbersome and error‑prone.

I need to reset my password for the Keelwater portal because I can’t access my account to upload claims documents.
The user cannot log in because they forgot their password and need to reset it.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not letting me in even though I’m sure I’m typing it right.
The user cannot log into the claims portal because the password reset is not working.

Our motor claims team really prefers automatic claim allocation to balance workload and match skills efficiently — it’s critical for scaling without adding headcount.
The motor claims team lacks automatic claim allocation, leading to workload imbalance and scaling challenges.
